args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release. v2.3.0 (the immediately preceding healthy release) is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so the rollback was performed to v2.2.9, which is now rolled out in all regions. Root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures still needs investigation.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Identified the most recent healthy production release as `v2.3.0`, but the rollback to it was rejected because `v2.3.0` is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417).
3. Rolled back to the next most recent healthy production release, `v2.2.9`, which is now rolled out in all regions (verified).
4. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the rollback and noting that the root cause of the `v2.3.1` health-check failures still needs investigation.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Identified the most recent healthy production release as `v2.3.0`, but the rollback to it was rejected because `v2.3.0` is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417).
3. Rolled back to the next most recent healthy production release, `v2.2.9`, which is now rolled out in all regions (verified).
4. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the rollback and noting that the root cause of the `v2.3.1` health-check failures still needs investigation.
